headline: Catawba and Lincoln Memorial take the first conference wins
dek: Catawba have scored nine and conceded three without losing, and seven different players have scored for them. Lincoln Memorial took the opening conference round's other win, and Wingate's goal was breached for the first time this season.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Mars Hill's thirteen goals are spread across eight different scorers, and no one of them has more than Logan Knight's four.

wire.line: Only Anderson and Catawba remain unbeaten; Emory & Henry still have no published result at all.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and every match Emory & Henry have had so far, the home match against Lynn among them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry have lost all three of the matches that carry a result, scoring once and conceding nine. Giuseppe Gereau is the only player to have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lenoir-Rhyne have scored eight and conceded ten, and remain without a win: two draws, two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Anderson's Asher Risell has kept two clean sheets and conceded three goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Carson-Newman's Elijah Buford has made fourteen saves and been beaten twice, without yet keeping a clean sheet.

last_match.line: Anderson have still not lost; Coker's first goals of the season came in defeat.

next_match.line: Mars Hill have scored more than any other programme, and lost their last match at Saint Leo.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
